description: Make visual baseline contract hashing independent of the executing harness while preserving current approved baseline signatures; validate Codex and Pi equivalence without modifying baseline records.
acceptanceCriteria: The visual baseline contract hash remains byte-for-byte compatible with existing Pi-approved records when only context.harness changes to Codex.
Visual or browser configuration changes continue to change the visual baseline contract hash.
Baseline registry, approval signatures, and PNG bytes remain unchanged.
The Codex PR visual gate no longer reports executor-only contract mismatches; any remaining findings are preserved.
